document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Shining your flashlight down a partly-collapsed corridor, you see 
a treasure trove of alien scientific devices beyond. The balance 
of the ceiling is precarious, but it has held for millions of years. 
If you don’t want to go in, go on to 559. 
If you do want to investigate, you crawl down the narrow 
passage. Nervously, you begin to pull out the devices. But as you 
do, you see glinting eyes and hear a cruel chuckle at the other 
end. You frantically back into the room of the scientific devices. 
The corridor collapses, pulled down by Jeffries’ treachery. You 
pound and tug at the stone, but the only way is sealed. Before 
you freeze to death, you hear great upheavals in the earth. You 
never know their cause. For you, and everyone, it is... THE END.
(555, 564)
